ai-workflows.title: AI Workflows
ai-workflows.subtitle: Manual admin becomes a working system.
ai-workflows.heroDescription: From incoming request to closed task. Extraction, checks, approval, action. Full trace back.

example.title: In practice
example.body: Supplier inboxes get parsed, matched to purchase orders, and only routed to a human on doubt.

kennissystemen.title: Private Knowledge Systems
kennissystemen.subtitle: Internal knowledge becomes usable.
kennissystemen.heroDescription: Answers to internal questions, grounded in your own documents. With sources. With permissions. No public API.

example.title: In practice
example.body: A staff member asks about a procedure. The system shows the right policy article, with the source page.

documentverwerking.title: Document & Data Processing
documentverwerking.subtitle: PDFs become data.
documentverwerking.heroDescription: Extraction pipelines that turn unstructured files into validated data. Doubt routes to a human.

example.title: In practice
example.body: Invoices get extracted, checked against purchase orders, queued for approval in the accounting tool.

integraties.title: Systems Integration
integraties.subtitle: One system, not seven tools.
integraties.heroDescription: The connective layer between your existing systems. With logs, retries and error handling you can read.

example.title: In practice
example.body: A webshop order creates an invoice, reduces stock and opens a service-desk ticket automatically.

softwareontwikkeling.title: Custom Software Development
softwareontwikkeling.subtitle: The foundation AI runs on.
softwareontwikkeling.heroDescription: Before AI solves anything, someone has to build the application that runs it. That's the core skill here.

example.title: In practice
example.body: A client portal where businesses log in, follow status and open tickets. Wired into the internal tools.
